_meta._comment: Phase 1 complete on real hardware 2026-07-28 (transport sanity — scan, connect, GATT, GAP/device-info reads, notification stream). Phase 2 complete 2026-07-29: commands.recording is VERIFIED via a 3/3 CameraSession round trip (see that block's provenance). ble_name re-confirmed by examples/scan_camera.py on v8.6 rather than inherited: the physical unit (BLE address CC:86:EC:72:E0:A6) is the same one upgraded from v7.9 on 2026-07-27, and the advertisement name identifies the hardware, not the firmware. Phase 3 in progress 2026-07-30: the passive settings sweep (step 9) populated `codecs`, most of `resolutions`, and the report-side coordinates of commands.codec_quality and commands.recording_format — all CANDIDATE, no write yet sent on this firmware. commands.video_format and a partial fps_modes (23.98/24/30) were then added as explicit CANDIDATE hypotheses to unblock step 10, which cannot build a probe packet without them — see docs/settings.md 18.6 and those blocks' own provenance. A follow-up dedicated fps sweep (2026-07-30) filled in 25/29.97/50/59.94 and reconfirmed 30 byte-identically across two independent sessions; 60fps initially looked like a candidate ceiling (silent twice) but three follow-up standalone attempts the same day reported it cleanly twice (byte-identical, matching the exact-rate flags pattern) — the ceiling hypothesis is retracted, fps_modes is now 8/8, and the earlier silences are recorded as an open report-observability question, not a camera limitation (docs/settings.md 18.7/18.8). Step 10's full 0x00-0x1F dimension_enum sweep (2026-07-30) then confirmed all 8 enums this camera family is known to have — matching both POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9's and POCKET_6K_PRO_v8.6's numbers exactly — and supplied HD's width/height, which step 9's passive capture had missed. commands.video_format is promoted from a bare hypothesis to a coordinates-confirmed CANDIDATE as a result. Still outstanding for Phase 3: the ProRes/4K DCI enum gap (same open question as both other profiles, not yet investigated to their depth on this firmware), a confirming write for all three settings families (step 12), and the full CameraSession round trip (step 13) needed to promote codec_quality/video_format/recording_format to VERIFIED. _meta.status stays UNVERIFIED because it describes the WHOLE profile; each command block carries its own provenance.status — recording's is already VERIFIED.

All 3 expected services and all 10 expected characteristics in constants.py were found with 0 missing and 0 extra, so no characteristic_incoming override is needed on this firmware.

gap_meta_data._comment: Confirmed readable 2026-07-28 by tools/query/gap_meta_data.py on real v8.6 hardware: DEVICE_NAME read back 'A:AF3DC814' and APPEARANCE read back 0x8403 (33795), after which the session disconnected only on its own intentional teardown. NOTE — this is a behavioural CHANGE FROM v7.9, where reading GAP characteristics disconnected the camera and the field was therefore set false. Re-checked on this firmware per the workflow's firmware-upgrade rule; the v7.9 hazard did not reproduce.

Also a change from the v7.9 profile, which records false.

provenance.method: passive sniffer (sniffer_recording.py) + guided discovery (discover_command.py, manual --category/--parameter seed) with per-candidate operator confirmation and wire echoes, then deterministic active send (send_record_command.py) and an echo-verified CameraSession round trip (examples/record_start_stop.py, 3/3 cycles)

provenance.notes: Re-sniffed on v8.6, not inherited from the v7.9 profile (design principle 6) — and the reserved byte genuinely differs, which is why that matters. RESERVED BYTE INDIFFERENT: the 2026-07-29 sweep sent all four (value, reserved) combinations and the camera acted on every one, so 0x00 and 0x01 both work; v7.9 records 0x01, this profile records 0x00. 0x00 is canonical here because it is the only reserved value with a clean wire echo for BOTH outcomes (start 'FF 0A 00 00 0A 01 01 02 02 00 40 00 01 03', stop 'FF 0A 00 00 0A 01 01 02 00 00 40 00 01 03'), and because it matches the reserved byte the camera itself uses in every camera-originated report on this family. The reserved=0x01 start candidate was operator-confirmed only — its capture window caught the post-connect initial-payload burst instead of the response (the known first-candidate race in docs/command_discovery.md's safety model), so it has no echo of its own; reserved=0x01 stop did echo cleanly. Echo payload trailing bytes '00 40 00 01 03' are identical to v7.9's and remain not understood (hypothesis: SDI Cat 10 Param 1 transport-mode struct, docs/protocol.md). PROMOTED TO VERIFIED 2026-07-29 on Phase 2 steps 8.4 and 8.5: send_record_command.py produced clean echoes for both directions, then examples/record_start_stop.py ran the real CameraSession echo-verified round trip 3/3 start, 3/3 stop, 0/3 stopped early, clip durations 7s/5s/4s. Every TX in that run was byte-exact to this block ('FF 05 00 00 0A 01 01 00 02' / '... 00 00', 3 each), so the reserved=0x00 choice is confirmed through the production write path, not just the discovery tool. TIMECODE also read 00:00:00:00 at each start, matching docs/timecode.md's finding that the camera resets it on record start.

provenance.method: passive sniffer (sniffer_settings.py), one capture window per concrete codec/variant so each payload is unambiguously attributable
provenance.notes: REPORT SIDE ONLY so far. Camera-originated 0x0A/0x00 reports confirmed on v8.6: operation 0x02 (CAMERA_REPORT), data-type byte 0x01 (INT8), payload exactly 2 bytes [codec_id, variant_id], header reserved byte 0x00. Every codec id and variant id in the top-level `codecs` table came from one of these reports, each in its own dedicated capture window. THE WRITE SIDE IS UNTESTED on this firmware: `reserved` here is the byte the camera uses in its own reports, not a confirmed write value, and no write has been sent. Phase 3 step 12 (send_settings_command.py --packet codec_quality) is what promotes this. If the write is refused, the v7.9 profile's write-side value for this family is also reserved=0, so that is not the first thing to vary.

provenance.method: passive sniffer (sniffer_settings.py), one capture window per concrete resolution and per concrete fps so each payload is unambiguously attributable

tools/captures/POCKET_6K_G2_v8.6/POCKET_6K_G2_v8.6_20260730T155537.json (dedicated fps sweep, one window per fps, local/gitignored)
provenance.notes: REPORT SIDE ONLY so far. Camera-originated 0x01/0x09 reports confirmed on v8.6: operation 0x02 (CAMERA_REPORT), data-type byte 0x02 (INT16), payload five little-endian int16 [fps_int, sensor_fps_int, width, height, flags], header reserved byte 0x00. Every width/height in the top-level `resolutions` table came from one of these reports. THE WRITE SIDE IS UNTESTED on this firmware and this block deliberately records what v8.6's own wire showed rather than v7.9's write-side values (design principle 6): data_type is INT16 (0x02, the observed report byte) and reserved is 0x00. NOTE FOR PHASE 3 STEP 12: on v7.9 the working WRITE used data-type byte 0x82 (INT16_ARRAY) and reserved 0x01, even though that camera also *reported* with 0x02 — so if a write from this block is refused, retry with `send_settings_command.py --data-type INT16_ARRAY` before assuming anything about the values, and only then edit this block. FLAGS FIELD: element 5 is not purely fps-derived. It read 0x0000 at 6K (6144x3456) and UHD, and 0x0010 at every windowed/cropped resolution, all at the same fps_int=24 — independently reconfirming on v8.6 the 'windowed mode' bit already noted in the v7.9 profile's fps_modes._comment and in docs/photo_capture.md 10.1. 23.98fps added 0x0003 on top (0x0013 total) where exact rates stayed 0x0010, so the low bits carry the NTSC/drop indicator — reconfirmed by the full fps sweep (docs/settings.md 18.7): every NTSC/drop rate (23.98/29.97/59.94) shows 0x0013, every exact rate (24/25/30/50/60) shows 0x0010. RETRACTED FINDING: fps_60 initially looked silent across two sweeps and was recorded as a candidate ceiling; three follow-up standalone attempts reported it cleanly twice (2/3), byte-identical to each other and matching the exact-rate pattern — see docs/settings.md 18.8. The camera demonstrably reaches and reports this state, so there is no ceiling here; the three silent attempts (2 original + 1 of the 3 retries) are an open report-observability question, not a capability finding.

provenance.method: active send (tools/control/sweep_dimension_enum.py, full 0x00-0x1F sweep, --fps 24, 2026-07-30). Coordinates and reserved byte now confirmed working, not just a hypothesis: 8 of 32 candidates produced genuine, repeatable resolution transitions on the recording_format (0x01/0x09) mode-notify channel, none flagged STALE MATCH by the tool's own repeat-check guard. video_format's own channel (0x01/0x00) still never echoes, matching every other camera tried.

provenance.notes: RESOLVES THE 'WEAKEST FIELD' CONCERN THIS BLOCK ORIGINALLY FLAGGED: sweep_dimension_enum.py always encodes with reserved=spec.reserved (no override path in that tool — confirmed by reading its source, not inferred from the summary alone), so all 32 sends in this run used reserved=0x01, the value already in this block. 8 clean matches at that reserved byte is real confirmation it works, not just a surviving hypothesis. THE 8 CONFIRMED ENUMS MATCH BOTH POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9's AND POCKET_6K_PRO_v8.6's NUMBERS EXACTLY: 0x03 HD, 0x06 UHD, 0x08 4K DCI/BRAW, 0x0D 2.8K 17:9/BRAW, 0x0F 3.7K Anamorphic/BRAW, 0x12 5.7K 17:9/BRAW, 0x13 6K/BRAW, 0x14 6K 2.4:1/BRAW — independently sniffed on this firmware's own wire (design principle 6), not copied; the cross-profile agreement is a finding, not the source. Same known gap as both other profiles: no ProRes/4K DCI enum found anywhere in the exhausted 0x00-0x1F range — NOT yet promoted to resolutions.'4K DCI'.known_unreachable.ProRes on this profile, since (unlike the PRO) the write-value hypothesis space (data_type byte, Operation, the two-step video_format-then-recording_format proxy that works on v7.9) hasn't been tried here yet; that investigation is Phase 3's next open item, not this sweep's job. Each matched enum also reset codec_quality to a per-codec-family default (ProRes->HQ, BRAW->5:1), reconfirming on this firmware the already-established mechanism (docs/settings.md) where a codec-family switch via video_format resets/restores quality rather than codec_quality itself switching families. STATUS IS STILL CANDIDATE, NOT VERIFIED: promotion needs the full CameraSession round trip (examples/change_codec.py, Phase 3 step 13), not yet run on v8.6.

codecs._comment: Sniffed on v8.6 2026-07-30, one capture window per concrete codec/variant; provenance rides with commands.codec_quality. Nothing inherited from POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9.json (design principle 6) — the values happen to match that profile, which is a confirmation, not a copy. BRAW variant id 6 was not observed on v8.6 either (a real gap between 12:1 at 5 and Q1 at 7) — do not invent it. The ProRes variant named 'Proxy' here was captured in a window the operator labelled 'pxy'; the id (3) is what was sniffed, the name follows this codebase's existing convention.

resolutions._comment: Widths/heights sniffed on v8.6 2026-07-30 from 0x01/0x09 reports (step 9, passive); dimension_enums added 2026-07-30 from a full 0x00-0x1F active sweep (step 10, tools/control/sweep_dimension_enum.py --fps 24) — see commands.video_format's provenance for the sweep's full evidentiary detail. All 8 confirmed enums match both POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9's and POCKET_6K_PRO_v8.6's numbers exactly, independently sniffed here rather than copied (design principle 6). HD's width/height came from this same sweep: its own passive capture window (step 9) had caught the post-connect burst instead of a report, so this profile went without HD until the active probe supplied it directly via the 0x01/0x09 transition at enum 0x03. No ProRes/4K DCI enum found anywhere in the exhausted range — the same known gap already documented on both other profiles — but NOT yet promoted to known_unreachable here; that needs the fuller write-value investigation (data_type, Operation, the two-step proxy) neither of those profiles' gap-closing work has been repeated on this firmware yet. The `codecs` list per entry records which codec family the operator reached that resolution under on the camera's own menus. 2.8K 17:9's width (2880) is now confirmed three ways on this firmware: the step 9 passive capture, this step 10 active probe, and a direct visual check of the camera's own on-screen display (operator-confirmed, 2026-07-30) — no ambiguity remains for v8.6. The v7.9 profile still records 2868 for the same label; whether that was ever accurate for v7.9 specifically remains unresolved and unfalsifiable now that camera can no longer be re-tested (see docs/settings.md 18.1). Do not reconcile the two profiles by editing either value — the discrepancy is about v7.9's own history, not about v8.6's number, which is settled.

fps_modes._comment: 8 of 8 modes, all CANDIDATE. fps_int and frame_flags read directly off v8.6's own 0x01/0x09 reports (2026-07-30, docs/settings.md 18/18.7/18.8), all at 2.8K 17:9 BRAW: 23.98 -> flags 0x0013, 24 -> 0x0010, 25 -> 0x0010, 29.97 (encodes as fps_int 30) -> 0x0013, 30 -> 0x0010 (reconfirmed byte-identical across two separate sweep sessions), 50 -> 0x0010, 59.94 (encodes as fps_int 60) -> 0x0013, 60 -> 0x0010 (reconfirmed byte-identical across two of five attempts — see docs/settings.md 18.8; the other three attempts were silent for reasons not fully explained, but that is a report-observability question, not evidence against reachability, since the camera demonstrably reaches and reports this exact state). m_rate IS THE ONE INFERRED FIELD in every entry: it is a video_format element and video_format never reports passively, so it cannot be observed at all until step 10's active probe. The inference is grounded in this firmware's own wire rather than another profile: the windowed-sensor bit is 0x0010, so an extra 0x0003 on top (0x0013 total) is the NTSC/drop indicator, giving m_rate=1 for 23.98/29.97/59.94 and 0 for the five exact rates. Confirmed or refuted by step 10/12.
